The [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] bore a close resemblance to a '''giant beast''' of legend that had origins in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="ATATSpecPlate">[["AT-AT" SpecPlate]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The legendary beast was mentioned on the [["AT-AT" SpecPlate]],<ref name="ATATSpecPlate" /> a fine-art print designed by [[Jeff McGuigan]] and [[Louis Solis]] and released by [[Acme Archives Direct]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Exclusive Preview">{{SW|url=news/acme-archives-directs-at-at-specplate-now-available-exclusive-preview|text=Acme Archives Direct's AT-AT SpecPlate - Exclusive Preview!}}</ref>
